title: Surface material train and eval constraint mismatches
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Taloneth needs comparable runs to record and flag mismatches in output caps, tool budgets, timeouts, and sampling so train and eval behavior stay aligned. Accepts FineEnvs train/eval parity findings. They walk product steps (compare_run_parity) and verify completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. [^fineenvs-parity]
implementation: `compare_parity` / `parity_from_harness_config` in `mechaharness.run_parity` compare harness constraint surfaces. `CliInstrumentor` verb `compare_run_parity` exposes the diagnostic.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `parity_mismatch.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
